description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Physical Mutation

If you're male you grow a single breast, if you're female you grow 1d6. They produce a sweet, intoxicating milk that induces a sense of ecstasy in those who drink it. Part of the effect is making the induced crave vivid stimulus for their senses, preferably in exaggerated ways; through dance, sex, violence and so on. They gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.9h82z72XGo9tfgQS]{Acute Sense} (All) Talent, +1 Movement, +10 Agility and +10 Initiative for the duration of 4 hours per dose (only the duration stacks). Afterwards they gain 1 @Condition[Fatigued] Condition per consumed dose. The milk is highly addictive and anyone consuming it must pass an Easy (+20) Endurance Test or gain the @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.fPZ6WhDgSEL2CRKA]{Addiction} (Ecstatic Milk) mutation. You are yourself immune to the effects of the milk. You can produce TB doses per day.
